cdm_spec_example.source: NOAA Office of Space Commerce, TraCSS CDM Specification v2.1
cdm_spec_example.note: Official TraCSS specification example used to validate the CDM/Pc/covariance data path. Values are not represented as a live operational conjunction.

tracss_ca_verification_protocol.source: NOAA Office of Space Commerce, Dataset for Conjunction Assessment Verification User Guide (March 2026)
tracss_ca_verification_protocol.candidate_ocm_rule: Nominal and maneuver-candidate ephemerides sharing an object designator are each screened against all external objects; ephemerides of the same object designator are not screened against one another.
tracss_ca_verification_protocol.access_note: Large answer-key files are full/open CC0 but hosted in Google Drive and require access request; this v1.4 package implements the schema/validation path using public documentation and the official CDM specification example.
